content: Plan: implementing publish.rs (OutboundPublisher + PublishError), polaris_federation_escalate.rs admin binary, and federation_publish_privacy.rs test file. Worktree is missing #107/#108 federation files and #103 lexicon_mapping — writing new code as if those dependencies exist (architect will reconcile on merge). Key decisions: (1) use existing active_signer watch channel from ApiState, (2) JSON-serialise the wire escalation then encode as DAG-CBOR matching the label emitter pattern, (3) use XrpcClient::procedure for the createRecord call, (4) privacy boundary stays in polaris_types::lexicon_mapping::to_lexicon_escalation — no strip logic in publish.rs.
